Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan on the mental side of training and competing, in four volumes (about 3.5 hours, originally with an e-book). Volume 1 covers training schedules and short- versus long-term goals. Volume 2 covers losing rounds in training and deliberately putting yourself in bad spots. Volume 3 covers funding an athletic lifestyle, drilling versus not drilling, and sports psychologists. Volume 4 covers dealing with losses and injuries ('you either win or you learn').
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Competitors and serious hobbyists thinking about how they train.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: A short two-part gi passing course from Gordon Ryan (about 1h 45m), covering the passes he relies on in the gi. Part 1 covers getting from spider guard to the toreando, toreando footwork, the toreando / leg drag / X-pass 'trilemma' and the toreando / long step dilemma. Part 2 covers the long step into half guard, using a free hand, and basic half guard passes.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Gi players who like Gordon's no-gi passing ideas and want them with grips.
key: Toreando, leg drag and X-pass trilemma

files.HighPercentageGiPassesbyGordonRyan1.mp4: Part 1: intro; spider guard to toreando; toreando footwork; toreando / leg drag / X-pass trilemma; toreando / long step dilemma.
files.HighPercentageGiPassesbyGordonRyan2.mp4: Part 2: long step into half guard; the luxury of a free hand; basic half guard passes; outro.

sources: Chapters.rtf included in the course folder.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's guard retention course in eight volumes (about 6.5 hours), organised by the kind of pass you're facing. Volume 1 covers retention principles and the top player's goals. Volume 2 covers retention using ashi garami and X guard. Volume 3 covers the split squat. Volume 4 covers retaining against the toreando. Volume 5 covers stack passing. Volume 6 covers half guard passing. Volumes 7 and 8 are guard retention rolls (Placido, Jack and others) followed by commentary on them.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi guard players who get passed; very systematic.
